english: Satoko~?　Satoko~, where~?\nGeez…… that girl,\nwhere did she run off to.
Ah, Shion-san.\nHello…….
Oh, perfect timing.\nHaven't you seen Satoko?
Probably out shopping with Mion-san and the others.
Geez…… sis.\nI'd have liked a heads-up too.
Sis…… ah, right.\nYou're twins with Mion-san.
Yes.\nIdentical twins.
Do our clothes and hairstyles make us look different?\nBut people say we're exactly alike.
Well, I'm more feminine than sis.
I can't lose to sis there.
I won't tell sis,\nso you can be honest.
You're both beauties……\nAnd…….
You've got nice bodies.
Really?\nI'm not very confident.
……Says she, striking a sexy pose…….
You're both so put-together…….
Huh?　You mean our insides?\nI don't think we're alike there.
With our family, I think sis is stricter.
But it's funny, since we look alike\ndown to our builds.
We can even swap clothes and play 'switch places'.
Wow~.\nA twins-only game.\nSounds fun…….
It was fun.\nWatching the adults' attitudes change…….
Well, I think we shouldn't do that\nanymore, though.
Once again, please take care of me and sis.
Well then……\nI'll go look for Satoko.\nGoodbye.
They look the same, but……\nher personality seems quite different\nfrom the energetic tomboy Mion-san…….
Oh, what's wrong?\nWith such a troubled face.
Um…… how do I deepen bonds\nbetween comrades…….
Hmm~……\nSo there's a specific girl\nyou want to get close to?
……I wonder?
Why are you asking me?\nI wouldn't know.
It's you, Shion-san…….
Oh, come on.\nYou're already close, aren't you?\nStill not satisfied?
Surprisingly greedy.
There are various ways……\nHow about 'club,' Hinamizawa-style.
Though it's just gathering after school\nand playing cards, board games, tag,\nnothing but fun.
True…… playing does bring people closer…….
Exactly.
Shion-san, want to do club with me?
With me?\n……I see, with me.
Sure.\nOh, but I forgot to mention……\nthe loser gets a punishment game.
What…… would that be like……?
Basically you do whatever the winner says.\nThe classic is 'serving in a maid outfit.'
Does that…… apply to men…… too?
Of course.\nJust ask sis and you'll understand.
Want to stop?\nI won't force you.
N-no…… I'm fine.\nI'll do it.
Well, wonderful.\nWhat shall we play?\nPick from this 'club box'.
Cards, sugoroku, shogi, assorted board games,\nballs, water guns…… a metal bat……\nall sorts in here.
A metal bat……?　Baseball?\n……Then, how about shogi?
Sure.\nI kind of know shogi.
How about here…….
……Then I'll take the bishop.
Huh?　Oh, I didn't notice.\nThat's mean…… I'm a beginner.
Ehh…… fine.\nThen I'll go here instead.
Really!?\nThank you.
Then, check.
Guh…… nothing.
I won!\nBut you went easy on me, right.
……Even so, a match is a match.\nNow, the punishment game.
Huh?　N-no……\nUWAAAAAH!!
It suits you!　The maid outfit suits you!\nPerfect!　Fufu…… fufufufufu!
(Scary!　Shion-san is scary!)
Oh, hello.
Ah, Shion-san……\nhello.
What's wrong?\nYou look pale.
No…… it's nothing.
My~.\nAfter such an embarrassing experience,\nyou've got guts~.
I respect that about you.
It's a bit…… traumatizing…….
Traumatizing?\nTo me it's a precious memory.
Just kidding.\nDon't be so scared.
So, shall we do it again today?\nClub.
If you're not feeling well,\nyou can decline……?
No, I'm fine.\nI can't stay a loser…….
Cool!\nJust like a boy!
Today, how about something simple, sugoroku?
Made by the club members……\nta-daa!
'Hinamizawa Gugyagya Sugoroku'~!
Wh-what a name…….
Now, let's decide the order.\nJan, ken…….
Pon!\nOh, I win.
Then I'll go first. Roll the dice…… ei!\n6!　Move 6 spaces…….
'Angel Mort is booming!\nBig-crowd special bonus,\nmove 3 more spaces!' Good start.
Ugh, a gap already……\nbut if I roll the same number……!
A 5.\n'Shaken down by punks in Okinomiya's shopping district!\nGo back 1 space.'
Too bad.\nMy turn.\nAh…… a 1.
I can still catch up…….
'Won the raffle and got a doll!\nMove 5 spaces!' Lucky!
Ahh…… the gap again…….
You're pretty good.\nImpressive that you've kept up.
I haven't lost yet.\n……A 6.
A last-minute surge……\nBut…….
'Hinamizawa Great Disaster…… go back to start……'?\nNo way…….
I rolled a 2.\nSorry.\nI win again.
Well then…….
Um…… Shion-san?\nWhy are you wiggling your hands like that……?
Pun-ish-ment.\nToday…… let's see…… with this 'device'\npassed down in the Sonozaki family basement…….
Wh-what is that……\nthat obviously ominous torture-device-looking thing…….
I'll have you take 'responsibility'…….
No…… stop……!\nGYAAAAAH!
So dramatic.\nI just clipped your nails.
N-nail clippers……?\nDon't you have bad taste……?
That…… is true.\nIt's only good for startling people.
Fufufu!\nBut just seeing that reaction\nwas worth it.
Oh, lost in thought?
I may not be able to do anything,\nbut I can listen.
I'm troubled about life…….
Whaaat!?\nSomething that serious?\nYou surprised me!!
No need to be that surprised…….
About how people see me…….
You worry about that?\nHmm~ well, neither good nor bad……\neveryone's like that, I'd say.
Aren't you really troubled\nabout how to win at club?
Fufufu. Thinking won't help.\nThe wins so far were flukes.\nYou'll surely win today.
I often lose to the members,\nand besides…….
I've always had bad luck.
Is…… that so……?
Yes. Even though we were born together as twins……\ncompared to Mion…….
The next head of the Sonozaki family,\nand her twin sister…… a huge difference.\nIn everything…….
(I don't know what to say……)
Just kidding!
Actually, this easygoing environment suits me.\n……I talked too much.
I'll win again today\nand you'll do the punishment game!
It's not decided yet……\nAnd you said I'd win just now…….
I said it's a possibility.
That's a way of saying the odds just dropped…….
Then, what shall we play?\nYou can choose.
(Shion-san is a girl, after all……\nI should win a physical match)
The 'club box' had a ball and a metal bat.\nUsing those…….
How about a batting contest?\nTaking turns as pitcher and batter.
Hmm…….
Baseball stuff…… is a bit…….
……I-is that so……\nThen, another match…….
Sorry.\nI'm not feeling it today.\nCan we do it another time?
Ah, Shion-san…… she left……\nWhat's wrong…… all of a sudden…….
Oh, helloo~.
H-helloo……?\nNot sure what that means,\nbut glad you're in a good mood.
In a great mood.\nNapping Satoko's sleeping face is so cute.
Ahaha. Good.\nYou left suddenly last time……\nI was a little worried.
Ah……!\nCome to think of it…… last time I……\num…… that was…… how do I put it…….
……Sorry……\nSeeing the baseball gear…… reminded me…….
……Until recently……\nI was a manager.\nOf a sandlot baseball team.
……Some bad memory?
No…… it's not that……\nThose days were really fun……\nI got to cheer on someone I loved, up close…….
Someone you loved…… that is…….
An ace pitcher who throws magic pitches……?\nLike a blazing fastball from a back-bending high jump.
Ahaha, that's funny.\nThat'd probably be a balk.
Your husband……?
……Funny joke.\nOf course, I'm not married yet.
The answer: a slugger who bats .300.\nBut the type who chokes under pressure.
Cool……\nand a really kind person.
Tee hee☆ I became manager\nbecause I wanted to stay with him\nas long as possible…….
You two were lovey-dovey.\nSo happy.
Yes. I really was happy.\nUntil he……\nsuddenly disappeared…….
……I can't say details……\nbut one day, he vanished.\nLeaving me behind…….
I see……\nSorry for reminding you…….
Oh, don't make that face.\nYou did nothing wrong.\nI need to…… be stronger…….
……You're strong…… Shion-san.
Ufufu……\nThat's right. Women are strong.\nSo…….
Today's another punishment game!\nCome on, club!　Club!\nLet's play Concentration today.
Yes…… sounds good.\nLet's start.\nYou go first, Shion-san.
Really?\nThank you.
(After hearing that story,\nI want Shion-san to enjoy club……)
Oh?　They're all gone.\nI win.
Huh……?\nWhat about my turn?
It never came around to you.\nSorry.\nI guess I'm super lucky.
(Actually, I could identify almost all the cards\nby scratches and creases)
Now, the punishment game.
O-okay.\nI'll do the punishment game. Gracefully.
Good resolve.\nThen gracefully do it.\nWear this.
Th-this is……!\nA sch-school swimsuit!
It suits you!　It really suits you!\nThis is a masterpiece!\nI want to show Satoko too!
Why this humiliation play…… ugh.
……Hm?
Whoa!?
A baseball……?
Nice catch!
What's with the sudden……?\nYou startled me…….
I wanted to play catch.\nNot a match, just relaxing.\nI brought gloves too.
Baseball stuff……\nI wasn't feeling it, but…….
You listened to me the other day,\nand I feel a bit refreshed…….
I can't……\ngo on like this……\nI want to be…… more positive…….
Shion-san.\nHere it comes.
……Your slender arms must have it tough,\nso shall I go easy?
Fufufu.\nQuite the big talker.\nFine. Full strength.
……Huh!?\nWhat is this pathetic throw.\nNo need to hold back, you know?
Full strength is fine, I said.\nThen I'll return it with full strength!
Ow……!?\nI'm wearing a glove, so why did that\nnearly rip my shoulder off……?
I wasn't a baseball manager for nothing!
I think……\nbeing a manager has nothing to do with it.
Now, let's keep going!
Haa. Good sweat!\nMoving your body really is great.
The gloom in my chest feels like\nit's fading away.
……I see.\nGlad you enjoyed it.
Fufu…… you're kind.
That part of you……\nI don't dislike.
Th-that means…….
……You like me?
Huh……!\nIt's not like that!\n……'Like' is such…….
If I kissed you, you wouldn't use a stun gun?
Wh-wh-what are you saying!\nOf course I'd knock you out with a stun gun,\nabduct you, and tie you up…….
Wh-what are you trying\nto make me say!
I don't know anymore!
Surely not……\nbut is that…… what they call\nthe 'dere' in yandere……?
(Shion-san the other day……\nseemed a little bashful.\nThat means…… surely……)
So you were here.
Oh, Shion...
It's a fine day today, isn't it...
Huh?\nYeah, you're right about that.
Did you get a haircut?
Huh?\nI haven't changed it since last time.\nIt's not like I've had a chance to.
......Something's off with you.\nIs something wrong?
(Huh...? She seems like her usual self)
So, what'll we do today? Club.\nHow about the Hinamizawa branch school specialty, 'Aburaburo'?
What in the world is that...?
It's kind of like a little endurance contest.
You go first. But you'd better not move, okay?\nYou'll end up a human torch.
Let's... not do that one.
Then, how about we lay a steel beam between two buildings and...?
Let's not...\nI'd rather have a nice, wholesome contest...\nLike a 'giant curry speed-eating contest'...
You're a guy, so obviously you'd have the advantage.
Hmm, let me think...\nHow about a 'jumbo parfait speed-eating contest'?
It's still speed-eating, but sweets are fine.\nI love them, after all.
I work part-time as a waitress at a family restaurant,\nso I can even make the parfaits myself.
...How about it?
Then it's settled.\nWhen it comes to speed-eating... I won't lose.
Oh? You've got some confidence you can win?
...Not really.\nI was just trying to psych myself up...
Fufufu.\nIs that so! Well, do your best!\nYou ought to win once in a while.
Actually...\nI've already got them ready!
...I'm not giving you any time to prepare.\nCome on, let's start.
Nom nom... ooh... so sweeeet...!\n...The ice cream's giving me brain freeze...
Oh my, that sounds rough.\nNom nom... yummy!
(Huh?\nShion's parfait doesn't have any ice cream in it...?)
...If you want to win, you need... preparation, you know?
Ugh!\nI can't lose!!
Whaaat!!?\nIf you pour it down like that...
...See, you're going to get a headache...\n...That bad...? You're overdoing it.
You wanted to win that badly?\nYou're such a kid.
I couldn't just stay a loser...
So, what should the penalty game be?\nThough... it doesn't look like you're in any shape for that right now.
Could you leave the penalty game to me?
I won't run away or anything...\nWell then, look forward to it later.
(...What is she planning?\nWell, whatever... I hadn't thought of anything anyway...)
(...I finally won...)
Hm? Where... am I?\nA school...?
We finally meet.\nSorry to keep you waiting.
Now then, my penalty game preparations are complete,\nshall we go?
Huh? Really?\n...Um... where to?
This is a cosplay café!
Cosplay...?\nDoes that mean... you too, Shion?
Of course!\nJust wait a moment, okay?
Thanks for waiting!\nS-so, how do I look?
I think it suits me pretty well,\nbut I want to hear what you think!
Yes, it suits you very well.
...That's all? That's a bit unsatisfying.\nAfter I went and dressed up like this...
You're always cute, Shion,\nso I figured I didn't need to say it again...
...! You say the most incredible things so casually!\nI feel like you've got me wrapped around your finger...
You're our customer today!\nI'll serve you plenty!\nJust ask for anything, okay!
Well then, right away...
Yes, anything you like!\nMy, aren't we bold.
Could I get a menu?
Ah, right...\n...Please don't make it sound like such a big deal.\nYou're embarrassing me.
If I slip up, just point it out as a slip-up, okay?
So, your order?
...Coffee and... napolitan?
Yes! Just a moment, please!
Here you go, thanks for waiting!\nI'd love to say it's handmade, but\nit's ready-made, so no complaints.
I don't... mind at all.
...Fufu.
Sorry.\nIt's just... watching you eat is making me happy somehow.
Just getting to watch the one I like like this, always...
Gehok...!\nD-did you just say... 'like'...?
Huh? ...Ahh!\nThat was... no... I mean... um...
...I... feel the same way about you, Shion...
...Wake up!
Nnngh...\nShion...? What about the cosplay?
Huh? Why would I have to do cosplay?
Don't tell me you wanted the penalty game\nto be cosplay? You should've just said so.
Huh? But... just now.
...Don't tell me you were doing weird things\nto me in your dream?
Even I wouldn't forgive that.
...Well, whatever.\nNo point blaming you for it...
Here, this is for you.\nIt's the penalty game, after all.
...What is it? Bread?
Me running errands for you like a gofer -\nthat's plenty of a penalty game, right?
Ah, that clears things up.\nI don't want to owe anyone anything...
Um... isn't your penalty lighter than mine was?
Is it?\nOther people's penalties probably just look lighter.
Come on... this is a bit much...\nI feel like I got ripped off...
Fufu.\nBeing with you is really fun.\nLet's play again sometime.
